summary: Leeds Bradford aerodrome closed and controlled airspace deactivated, with pilots asked to monitor the Leeds Radar frequency.
text:
LEEDS BRADFORD CTA, CTR, ATZ DEACTIVATED. AD CLSD. ATS NOT AVBL.
AIRSPACE REVERTS TO CLASS G. SUITABLY EQUIPPED ACFT WI LEEDS 
BRADFORD AIRSPACE SHOULD MONITOR LEEDS RADAR ON CH 134.580 AND 
SQUAWK 2677, ANY DISCRETE TASK SPECIFIC CODE, OR ANY DISCRETE CODE 
ALLOCATED BY ANOTHER UNIT. MET OBSERVATIONS UNVERIFIED.
